name: Qvalia
summary: Qvalia sends and receives e-invoices over Peppol, with six monthly plans in euros from 25 to 30,000 messages. Archiving of received invoices comes with the Large plan and above, not with Small or Medium.

facts.text: The e-invoicing page lists XRechnung, CII, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, EDIFACT, cXML, Svefaktura and Finvoice as upload formats available through the API. It says each invoice is checked against EN 16931 and the Peppol rules before it leaves.
Peppol is the default delivery route, and customers that cannot yet receive e-invoices can get the invoice as a PDF.
Archiving is listed as not included in Small and Medium and included in Large, 1X, 2X and 3X.
Additional messages on the Large plan are charged at EUR 0.50 each and billed in arrears. Each plan card says 'Billed monthly, cancel anytime.'
